about.name: Hyperliquid
about.description: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship decentralized exchange (DEX), the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, RWAs, and a full-fledged EVM.
about.categoryNote: Hyperliquid has no category of its own on DefiLlama, so this is the category of the sub-protocols with the most fees over 30 days. Its sub-protocols also cover: Dexs, Prediction Market, Bridge, Lending.

unlocks.summary: Core contributors' tokens were locked for one year after genesis, and the Hyper Foundation says most of their vesting schedules finish between 2027 and 2028, with some running past 2028. It hasn't published dates or amounts, so none are shown.

token.name: Hyperliquid
token.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

news.title: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
news.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
news.summary: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

news.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
news.summary: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies files to become CFTC-registered FCM, posts $13.3 million in quaterly revenue
news.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies posted $13.3M in revenue and $620.6M net income, and filed with the CFTC to become an FCM for U.S. HIP-3 perp markets.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies Posts $620.6 Million Profit on HYPE Paper Gains
news.summary: HYPE was trading about 14% below the price used to value the company's quarter-end token holdings.

news.title: NEAR Adds 24/7 NIFTY 50 Perpetual With Cross-Chain Funding
news.summary: The Hyperliquid-based contract allows up to 20x leverage and settles index-point gains and losses in USDC, without delivering Indian shares.
